subject: 🏃 Wednesday — 4 mi Easy / Deload Day 3 (Wk 8)
html:
Tomorrow you have 4 miles easy — HR Zone 2 (135–145), pace ~9:00–9:15 readout. This is the new Wednesday run slot (the heavy back squat day is retired — the knee never once complained about running, only about squats, so the back half leans into what's working). Run from the door on the hilly home roads, let pace float with the terrain, HR stays the governor. If the climbs pull HR above 145, ease off or walk until it drops.

Pre-run activation (5 min): quadruped hip CARs, banded lateral walks (10 each direction), glute bridges (10), plus quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side, PT-prescribed).

Focus cue: post-HM body scan at 72 hours. The Presidio bridge course dropped 555 ft of eccentric descent load on the quads and patellofemoral joint three days ago. By now the acute DOMS should be clearing — note what's still talking vs. what's resolved. Knee was 1/5 crossing the line Sunday; if it's held 1/5 through today, the durability signal from a hilly HM with real descents is as strong as it gets. Log it.

Where you are: Week 8 of 12, deload week, day 3. 32 days to race day. Holding 3:30, paces at VDOT 54. The Presidio pivot locked the goal and surfaced the binding constraint — fueling at race effort. That fix starts with Sunday's 10-mi long run (gel rehearsal at easy effort). Tomorrow is still pure recovery; the real training ramp begins Week 9 when volume jumps to ~44 miles with a 16-miler and 8 mi at MP.

Tonight: Recovery dinner — protein + carbs (fish + sweet potato or rice). Hydrate well. Bed by 10. Easy day tomorrow, nothing to stress about.
